tasks.title: Author the review-report contract and validator
tasks.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/review-report.schema.json as a flat markdown-frontmatter schema (required: schema_version const 1.0, project, reviewed_at date-time, decision enum approved|changes_requested; additionalProperties true, like handoff.schema.json). Add validateReviewReport(frontmatter, root) to cli/lib/validate.js using validateMarkdownArtifact, export it, import + re-export it in cli/appbuilder.js, and append 'review-report' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first: validateReviewReport unit tests (valid frontmatter passes; bad decision and missing required fields fail).
acceptance_criteria: review-report.schema.json validates flat frontmatter with a decision enum of approved|changes_requested.
validateReviewReport is exported from cli/lib/validate.js and re-exported from cli/appbuilder.js.

tasks.title: Implement the review verb (init + gate) and remove the start placeholder
tasks.description: Add cli/lib/review.js exporting review(cwd, args): `review init <slug>` gates on build/<slug>/test-report.json, refuses to overwrite build/<slug>/review-report.md without --force, and seeds flat frontmatter (schema_version 1.0, project, reviewed_at now ISO, decision changes_requested) plus ## Summary / ## Findings / ## Checklist headings (the seeded stub must pass frontmatter validation). `review <slug>` collects failures and passes only when test-report.json exists, review-report.md exists, its frontmatter validates, the required sections are present and non-empty, and decision == approved; on any failure it prints `fail review:` lines, exits 1, and writes nothing new. Wire `case "review"` in cli/appbuilder.js and add a 'Review commands:' help block. Remove the `case "start"` from the router and drop start from the help placeholder line (leaving ship). Test-first: review init seeds + gates on test-report; happy path (filled sections + decision approved passes); reds (no test-report, no review-report, decision changes_requested, an empty required section); start is now an unknown command.
acceptance_criteria: `appbuilder review init <slug>` seeds a schema-valid review-report.md and refuses unless build/<slug>/test-report.json exists.
`appbuilder review <slug>` passes only when test-report exists, the report validates, required sections are non-empty, and decision == approved; otherwise it exits non-zero and writes nothing new.
review is routed as its own command with help text; the start command is removed from the router and help.

tasks.title: Document the review phase and drop start from the docs
tasks.description: Add a Review section to README.md (the two verbs, what the gate checks, link to HOWTO) and a thorough review-phase walkthrough to HOWTO.md after the Test section (the two verbs, the gate rules incl. decision == approved, the review-report.md, a failure-mode -> fix table), renumbering the subsequent sections. Drop start from the README placeholder line and the HOWTO 'Later phases' note, leaving only ship. Docs only.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md has a thorough review-phase walkthrough with the gate rules and a failure-mode table; later sections renumbered.
README.md has a Review section; the placeholder/later-phases wording lists only ship (no start, no review).
doctor stays green (no broken plan-interview/onboarding references).
